review.notes: Whole-document word-level diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 14 physical PDF pages; the physical p.7/p.8 page-boundary sentence was rendered at 300 dpi. Code fences are absent, Tables 1-8 and their bodies are present, and the remaining diff gaps are page-number stamps, the arXiv side stamp, text-layer URL spacing artifacts, and figure-internal labels covered by embedded figure images. The OCR's conversion of two printed bullet glyphs to markdown dashes was left unchanged (bullet style is not a defect class).

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.7 bottom (300 dpi): the sentence starts "As shown in Table 1, the GLM-TTS-" and breaks across the page to p.8 "tokenizer significantly outperforms the GLM-4-Voice tokenizer..."; the hyphenated compound "GLM-TTS-tokenizer" is also printed in the same paragraph ("We evaluate GLM-TTS-tokenizer across two English test sets"). OCR joined the page-break halves without the hyphen or a space, producing "GLM-TTStokenizer".
